lines.t: The oceans rise at Your command,
The thunder shakes the waiting land,
The mountains bow, the heavens move,
Creation trembles at the truth.
The stars obey the voice You speak,
The roaring wind, the raging deep,
Yet still the hearts of men resist,
And turn away from covenant.
But somewhere in the darkened night,
A remnant lifts their eyes to light,
They hear correction as a song,
And in Your presence they belong.
You do not force the heart to love,
You do not force the heart to love,
You call us gently from above,
And every soul that turns to You
Is born again, remade anew.
The greatest sign is not the sea,
Not fire falling endlessly,
Not earthquakes shaking every throne,
Or wonders only feared and known.
The greatest sign the world will see
Is when Your love awakens me,
A heart of stone undone by grace,
Now beating only for Your name.
You loved me first, I answered true,
And all my heart was made anew.
You called the waves to rise again,
To warn the proud, awaken men,
But still they hardened all their ways,
And would not turn to seek Your face.
The earth will quake, the heavens shake,
The mighty kingdoms bend and break,
Yet in the midst of wrath and flame,
Your faithful still exalt Your name.
For those who truly walk with You
Shine brighter than the noonday blue,
Like summer sun on fields of gold,
Reflecting glory saints behold.
What gift is love if not received?
What life remains where hearts won’t yield?
But mercy waits with open hands
For every soul who understands.
The greatest sign is not the sea,
Not storms that rage catastrophically,
Not trumpets sounding through the skies,
Or blazing wonders in our eyes.
The greatest sign the world will know
Is when dead hearts begin to glow,
When rebels fall before the Stone
And rise transformed before the throne.
You loved me first, I answered true,
And all my heart was made anew.
Come out from among them,
Come into the light,
Run into His shelter,
Hide in His life.
Though nations rage around us,
Though every mountain moves,
There’s safety in the shadow
Of the Holy One we choose.
And even when the heavens
Are shaken from above,
I’ll rest within the refuge
Of everlasting love.
For every wave and every star,
Proclaims exactly who You are,
But still the miracle remains
That You would call us each by name.
And though the whole earth knows Your voice,
You gave to man the sacred choice,
So here I stand, surrendered fully,
My soul restored eternally.
The greatest sign beneath the sun
Is not what fear or wrath has done,
But that Your servant loves You too,
Because my heart was made anew.
You are my shelter from the storm,
My sanctuary evermore,
And I will shine before Your throne,
Loved by my God, forever known.
